teekasfigure.player.profile_info: Stage and camera move above Y=2048. Creative flight with hidden HUD. Clouds, entity shadows and view bobbing are off, particles minimal, view distance up to 2 chunks, simulation up to 5, FPS up to 60. Frames are prepared ahead and mobs reused. Outdated frames are skipped if playback falls behind. Viewing settings and your original game mode are restored on Stop or exit. F1 can toggle the HUD.
